title: eumachia cymuligera
intro: Eumachia cymuligera, commonly known as the Mexican prickly poppy, is a flowering plant species in the family Rubiaceae. The plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Eumachia cymuligera include anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and expectorant properties, which help to reduce inflammation, fever, and alleviate respiratory symptoms. The bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and iridoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
